en: a sudden good idea
ex: I've had a brainwave!
我灵机一动，想出了个主意来。

en: very intelligent
ex: He’s a brainy kid.
他是个聪明的孩子。

en: to cook meat or vegetables very slowly with a little liquid in a closed container
ex: braising steak (= that is suitable for braising)
供焖烧的肉排

en: (of water or soil) containing salt or alkali
ex: a brak, clay soil
荒芜的粘土

en: a device for slowing or stopping a vehicle
ex: to put/slam on the brakes
踩／猛踩刹车

en: liquid used in brakes to make the different parts move smoothly

zh: 刹车指示灯，制动灯（在车尾）
en: a red light on the back of a vehicle that comes on when the brakes are used

zh: （汽车盘式制动器上的）制动垫块
en: a thin block that presses onto the disc in a disc brake in a vehicle, in order to stop the vehicle

zh: a small soft black fruit that grows on a bush with thorns in gardens or in the countryside. The bush is also called a blackberry.
en: a wild bush with thorns on which blackberries grow

zh: a type of large apple, used in cooking
en: a type of large apple, used in cooking
the outer layer of grain which is left when the grain is made into flour
ex: breakfast cereal that contains bran
含麸皮的早餐麦片

zh: 摸彩桶（内有藏在麸皮、纸等中的奖品，供儿童游戏用）
en: a container that holds prizes hidden in bran, paper, etc., which children have to find as a game
a part of a tree that grows out from the main stem and on which leaves, flowers and fruit grow
ex: She climbed the tree and hid in the branches.
她爬上树，躲在树枝上。
